info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Account Data Access Tier-spec
info.description: This API allows businesses to manage account data access tiers for customers. By using this API, developers can create specific data access configurations tailored to individual customer needs. Common use cases include enhancing data security, providing granular access controls, and facilitating compliance with data management regulations. Target consumers of this API include application developers, data compliance officers, and system integrators looking to streamline account management processes.

post.summary: Create a Data Access Tier for a Customer's Account
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new data access tier specifically for a customer's account. By providing the required information, you can set up tiered access to data for improved management and service delivery.
